message.content: Saffron highlights the pivotal moment when Cersei Lannister loses her children as a significant event that profoundly shapes her character. This loss drives Cersei to embrace cruelty to maintain her grip on power, illustrating how personal tragedies can drastically alter a person's behavior and motivations. This event serves as a critical turning point in Cersei's character arc, emphasizing her complex interplay of power, ambition, and emotional depth.
